title: Saturation Specification
description: Defines the threshold conditions for induction — when accumulated advisory signals should generate a manifest proposal.

id.description: Unique identifier for this saturation rule.

zone_glob.description: Target zone(s) for this saturation rule. Supports glob patterns.

threshold_deposits.description: Minimum active deposit count to trigger induction.

threshold_lineages.description: Minimum independent actor count. Must be >= 2 (induction requires multi-actor convergence).

window_seconds.description: Time window within which deposits must accumulate.

kind_filter.description: Optional: only count signals of this kind toward saturation.

strength_minimum_milli.description: Optional: only count signals with strength at or above this threshold.

enabled.description: Whether this saturation rule is currently active.
